verdict.rationale: The evidence covers partitioning files into elements, chunking by title, page or similarity, per-page routing to partitioning strategies, and batch processing of multiple files. None of it documents classifying the document types inside a single uploaded packet or splitting that packet into separate per-document results. Per-page strategy routing and chunking are adjacent features, not packet classification and splitting.

support.subject: As a data engineer, multi-document packets are classified and split automatically — one upload, per-document results
